message: Cool assignment. While I haven't gone looking in a while, the most comprehensive treatment of remix pedagogy I've found is Rob Pope's *Textual Intervention: Critical and Creative Strategies for Literary Studies*, which was originally published in 1995 (I haven't seen it yet, but his new book *Creativity: Theory, History, Practice* should touch on this subject as well). It's geared towards literature, but much of it is applicable to composition, or can at least inform composition studies. We, of course, have our own growing list of works on the topic, but I though I'd mention Pope since I don't see him much discussed in comp circles. I've used some of Pope's techniques in literature classes, and I'd love to structure a whole course around *Textual Intervention*.
